answer.reason: Several verses tell events at Ramah: Baasha built it, Asa's men took it apart, and Nebuzaradan let Jeremiah go there.

clauses.english: was built by Baasha king of Israel to shut in Asa king of Judah
clauses.quote: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah

clauses.english: had its stones and timber carried off by Asa to build Geba and Mizpah
clauses.quote: they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof

clauses.english: was where Nebuzaradan let the chained Jeremiah go
clauses.quote: after that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah

doubts: MAT 27:57, MRK 15:43, LUK 23:51 and JHN 19:38 concern Arimathaea, a different place, and were left out.
JDG 4:5 is the summary's own verse; JDG 19:13, JOS 18:25, EZR 2:26 and NEH 7:30 only name Ramah as a lodging choice or in lists.

JER 31:15, MAT 2:18, ISA 10:29 and HOS 5:8 use Ramah as a figure of speech or a prophetic image, so they were not treated as events; the Ramah of the Jeremiah and Matthew weeping may also be a different place.
